generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of driving practice area (驾校练习场). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Stage a calm driving lesson on a clean closed practice ground, viewed from the front-left corner of one compact training car. The learner sits visibly at the wheel and the instructor stands beside the open passenger door without blocking the car. Arrange parking poles and one flexible bollard around a clearly painted bay, with a portable octagonal stop board to one side and a large direction arrow on the tarmac in the foreground. The roof sign must be a plain coloured block with no readable school name. Bright soft morning light, realistic road-school atmosphere, no other cars or crowds.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: driving instructor, learner driver, dual-control training car, driving-school roof sign, parallel-parking pole, painted parking bay, flexible traffic bollard, portable stop board, side-view mirror, road direction arrow.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
